branches.annual_formula: RSA 336:1, II supplies the annual simple-rate formula
branches.rate_lock: RSA 336:2 fixes the rate at verdict or the finding for pecuniary damages
branches.official_schedule: Judicial Branch annual schedule was inaccessible during review; no numeric value is inferred

annual_rate.notes: New Hampshire publishes 5.7% for 2026. RSA 336:1, II uses the final 26-week Treasury-bill auction before September 30 of the preceding year plus two points, rounded to one decimal place, and expressly calls the result an annual simple rate. RSA 336:2 fixes a particular judgment’s rate at verdict or the finding for pecuniary damages; an existing judgment does not reset each January. Day count and payment allocation remain unmodeled. Not legal advice.
